summary.intent: Insert a new phase (19.2) after phase 19 to implement and test IPFS upload performance optimizations identified in the phase 19 baselines, then kick off research and planning for that phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 (IPFS Upload Performance Optimization) was inserted into the roadmap, a feature branch was created, and the researcher agent completed — producing RESEARCH.md and VALIDATION.md with a key correction: steps 2+3 (not 1+2) are the actual parallelization opportunity.

repo: Phase 19 baselines incorrectly identified pins 1+2 (ciphertext + file metadata) as parallelizable — they cannot be because file metadata embeds the CID from the ciphertext pin. The real opportunity is steps 2+3 (file IPNS batch publish + folder metadata update).
The existing load test infrastructure in tests/load/ (vitest, mixed-workload and upload-throughput scenarios) is already capable of before/after performance comparison with percentile breakdowns.
Prometheus histograms (cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds) already capture server-side pin timing — no new observability work needed.
Phase 19.1 already existed when 19.2 was inserted; gsd-tools placed 19.2 before 19.1 in the file, requiring a manual ordering fix in ROADMAP.md.
Kubo's badgerds datastore is deprecated and scheduled for removal; pebbleds (LSM-tree) is the recommended alternative to flatfs for write-heavy pin workloads.

code.finding: The primary parallelization fix is ~10 lines: wrap two sequential awaits (steps 2+3 of the upload flow) in Promise.allSettled. No new dependencies required.

workflow: gsd-tools phase insert places the new entry immediately after the target phase number in the file, which may not respect existing decimal sub-phases — manual reordering may be needed.
A git worktree (../cipher-box-phase-20) can be created off main to work on phase 20 in parallel while phase 19.2 work proceeds on its feature branch.
The researcher agent can run as a background Task while other work (branch creation, worktree setup) proceeds concurrently.

friction: gsd-tools inserted phase 19.2 before 19.1 in ROADMAP.md instead of after it, requiring multiple manual Edit calls to fix the ordering and flesh out the phase details.
The phase 19 baselines document contained an incorrect assertion about which pin steps could be parallelized — the researcher had to correct this by tracing actual code dependencies.
open_items: pebbleds vs flatfs v0.40.0 performance comparison under CipherBox's specific workload (many small pins, moderate concurrency) — requires empirical testing, no published benchmarks exist.
Whether concurrent pin requests per upload hit Kubo internal write locks — empirical question to resolve during execution.
Whether IPFS_PROFILE=server,pebbleds correctly composes both profiles — needs local testing.
Planning for phase 19.2 not yet started — PLAN.md files still need to be created via /gsd:plan-phase 19.2.
Phase 20 worktree created but no work started there yet.
